## Knockout validation

The following barplot shows the intensities of the selected KO protein across samples:

```{r}
#| label: knockout validation

KOProtein <- metadata$KOProtein[1]

has_KOProtein <- length(KOProtein) == 1 &&
  !is.na(KOProtein) &&
  !(toupper(trimws(KOProtein)) %in% c("", "-", "NA"))

if (has_KOProtein) {

  df_KOProtein <- psm_proteinFiltered %>%
    filter(toupper(`Protein ID`) == toupper(trimws(KOProtein)))

  if (nrow(df_KOProtein) > 0) {

    plot_df <- df_KOProtein %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -`Protein ID`,
        names_to = "BioReplicate",
        values_to = "Abundance"
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata %>% select(BioReplicate, Condition),
        by = "BioReplicate"
      )

    ggplot(
      plot_df,
      aes(
        x = BioReplicate,
        y = Abundance,
        fill = Condition
      )
    ) +
      geom_col() +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = paste("Protein selected:", KOProtein),
        x = "Sample",
        y = "Abundance"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1,),
        legend.position = "none"
      )

  } else {
    cat("KO protein not found:", KOProtein)
  }

} else {
  cat("No valid KO protein selected (NA, '-', 'NA', or empty value)")
}
```
